name: 98109 · Seattle, WA
findings: ZIP 98109 (Seattle) has 207 nonprofit organizations. 113 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 87 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98109 (Seattle) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 13 arts and cultural organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.
